annotations.title: Send SMS, WhatsApp Templates & AI Voice Calls

description: Send transactional SMS messages ($0.004/msg), dispatch pre-approved WhatsApp Business Cloud template messages (`send_whatsapp_template`), initiate outbound AI Voice calls (`place_call`), or audit the telecom usage ledger (`logs`). Use this tool for instant out-of-band customer notifications, executive alerts, appointment reminders, or autonomous voice follow-ups. Returns dispatch confirmation, `messageId`, E.164 sender/recipient numbers, and exact per-message cost in USD.

action.description: Telecom dispatch action: 'send_sms' sends an E.164 text message, 'send_whatsapp_template' sends a WhatsApp Business message, 'place_call' initiates an outbound AI voice call, and 'logs' retrieves the telecom billing ledger.

body.description: UTF-8 message body for SMS or parameter payload for WhatsApp messages.

fromNumber.description: Sender E.164 phone number provisioned in the workspace (e.g. '+34919019988').

profileId.description: Brand profile identifier (`prof_...`) associated with the sender number.

templateName.description: Approved WhatsApp Business Cloud template identifier (e.g. 'executive_briefing_confirm' or 'order_status_update') when `action` is 'send_whatsapp_template'.

toNumber.description: Recipient E.164 phone number including country prefix (e.g. '+971500000000' or '+14155550199'). Required for 'send_sms', 'send_whatsapp_template', and 'place_call'.

voiceScriptOrAgentId.description: Spoken script text or Voice AI Agent ID to execute when placing an outbound call via `action: 'place_call'`.

name: telecom_messaging
